subject: [hw] R2 review D01 rev3: accept with findings — FACTS 1.10 has the infracfg SET/CLR offsets wrong; 4-vs-5 count
body:
FACTS.md is complete and every row has evidence + a mark; facts/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST D01 PASS 32/32. Two factual defects to fix before the next integrator reads it:

F22 medium  FACTS.md 1.10 says "MM SET 0x2D0 CLR 0x2D4 STA1 0x2EC" and "MM_2 SET 0xDC8 CLR 0xDD0". clk-mt6885-pg.c:225-241 names PROTECTEN_MM 0x2D0 (current/status), _SET 0x2D4, _CLR 0x2D8; MM_2 0xDC8, _SET 0xDCC, _CLR 0xDD0; STA1 0x2EC/0xDD8. K01/K02 use the correct offsets, so this is a documentation hazard. Rewrite as: MM 0x2D0 (set 0x2D4, clr 0x2D8, ack 0x2EC); MM_2 0xDC8 (set 0xDCC, clr 0xDD0, ack 0xDD8).
F23 low  FACTS 4.11: "The 4 unclassified mnemonics are" then five names (smmul, uxtb16, aese.8, sha1su1.32, sha256su0.32). Count=5; STATUS.md repeats it.
F24 low  rows 1.17, 1.22, 5.6, 6.4 carry [V]/[I]; split verified from inferred.
F25 low  1.7 omits the 4:2:2 IMG_STRIDE rule (mtk_jpeg_core.c:1177-1179: align(width*2,32)); K01 implements it.

No other finding; your imports/census/VCU numbers re-ran clean here (309511 reachable, 0 A32, 149 imports).
